name: Hisoka Hagakure
source:
Likes: Money, Business, Challenges, Family
Dislikes: Being poor, Vegetable
Hobby: Taking Hachi out for a walk
Skills: Judgement, Becoming friends with everybody

"You have such a cute smile. It's been a while to see a genuine smile like that."

Hugo: This merchant has come to this land from Hinomoto.
I've never met this kind of person, who has such a unique aura...
Something about him is different from a humankind...
Behind every smiling face, lies a secret, waiting to unravel, they say...
Maybe he has a story to tell...
Will this guy induce an effect on the future?
...I shall monitor him beside the Goddess of Time.
*Glare*

[Official in-game description]
